text:
Situation: Cytarabine is not on FDA's current shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 8.7 days of supply for the 100 mg/mL, 20 mL presentation; Corvale General holds 24.5 days. Other presentations at both sites and at Corvale Lakeside have 14 to 27 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA's history shows a cytarabine shortage first posted on 2021-09-24 and since resolved. FDA inspection 1110628 at Gland Pharma Limited ended 2019-11-01 and was classified VAI, with the classification letter dated 2019-12-10 — 693 days before the 2021 shortage posting. Gland Pharma Limited (FEI 3009056604) received VAI classifications in 2013, 2015, and 2019; its most recent inspection was NAI on 2023-07-28.

Our position: No national shortage exists. The imbalance is local to Corvale East for the 100 mg/mL, 20 mL vial. Internal redistribution can resolve the gap without new purchases.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 16 vials of cytarabine 100 mg/mL, 20 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — approved by pharmacy director (transfer request).
2. Substitute cytarabine 20 mg/mL from Gland Pharma Limited (alternate NDC) — approved by pharmacist; substitution previously approved by Riley Brooks, PharmD on 2026-01-15.
3. Substitute cytarabine 20 mg/mL from Hospira, Inc. (recalculate dose and volume) — approved by pharmacist; substitution previously approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD on 2025-10-06.

Not recommended: New purchases from Meitheal Pharmaceuticals Inc. or Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC while internal supply and approved substitutions cover the need.
